name: Custom Post Type
description: Adds a CPT class extending AbstractPostType from rtcamp/wp-framework. One class per post type; the consumer's PostTypes module instantiates it via the Loader.

inputs.description: PSR-4 namespace for the post type class. Default 'Inc\PostTypes' matches the rtCamp skeleton; pass the project's actual sub-namespace (e.g. 'Acme\Blog\PostTypes') to override.
Directory for the post type file. Default 'includes/PostTypes' matches the rtCamp skeleton; pass the project's actual sub-path to override.
PSR-4 namespace for the test class. Default 'Inc\Tests\PostTypes'.
Directory for the test file. Default 'tests/PostTypes'.
i18n text domain. Usually matches the plugin slug.
Post type slug (kebab-case, used as the key in register_post_type(), e.g. 'product').
PascalCase class name, derived from slug.
Dashicon class or SVG URL for the admin sidebar.

wiring.description: Add the new CPT class to the PostTypes module's get_classes() array. The framework's Loader will instantiate it and call register_hooks() on init. If the PostTypes module does not exist yet, scaffold it first via `wp-tooling add wp/module --name=PostTypes --kind=cpt`.
